measured_profile_evidence.interpretation: First matching study kernel, normally warmup invocation, under Nsight replay/defaultcachepolicy. Duration differs from required host-clock trial means; no subtraction/decomposition or sustained-DRAM bound inference. DRAMwrite0 can reflect cache residency; L2 transactions are a distinct memory level. FP64 transcendental work is not fully described by ordinary-FLOP roofline counters.
